instanceLogWindow.errors.duplicateMod.source: You have the same mod installed twice — check the instance's mod list.

instanceLogWindow.errors.insufficientSys.source: You asked for more RAM than your computer has available — lower the maximum in Settings.

instanceLogWindow.errors.jniError.source: A conflict between mods, or a Java version incompatible with this instance.

instanceLogWindow.errors.missingDependen.source: A mod is missing a dependency it needs — check whether you installed everything it required.

instanceLogWindow.errors.mixinConflict.source: A mod (mixin) clashed with another — try removing the last mod you installed.

instanceLogWindow.errors.nativeCrash.source: The JVM crashed natively (not a specific mod error) — could be outdated video drivers, or not enough real RAM on the computer. Java left an hs_err_pid*.log with details in the instance folder.

instanceLogWindow.errors.outOfMemory.source: Ran out of allocated RAM — try raising the maximum RAM in Settings.

instanceLogWindow.errors.unsupportedJava.source: This Minecraft version needs a newer Java version than the one installed.

instanceLogWindow.exitNullCode.source: The game closed abruptly without warning — usually the operating system cutting off the process due to lack of RAM. Try raising the maximum memory in Settings.

instanceLogWindow.exitOom.source: The operating system cut off the game due to lack of RAM (not just what's assigned to the game — the computer's actual memory). Close other programs or lower the maximum memory in Settings.

instanceLogWindow.exitOtherCode.source: The game closed with code {{code}} without a recognizable error in the log — with several mods installed, this is usually a lack of RAM. Try raising the maximum memory in Settings.

instanceLogWindow.rollbackHint.source: If the game started failing right after updating mods:

serverInstance.connectionLanHint.source: For another PC on the same Wi-Fi, give them this address as is.

serverInstance.connectionPublicManual.source: This address works for anyone, but your router didn't let TFL Client open it automatically: you'll need to port forward {{port}} manually — search "port forwarding" plus your router model.

serverInstance.connectionPublicReady.source: This address works for anyone, anywhere — TFL Client opened the port on your router automatically.

serverInstance.connectionTunnelReady.source: This address works for anyone, anywhere — it doesn't depend on your router.

serverInstance.connectionUnavailable.source: Couldn't detect a network address — check that you have internet or a local network connection.

serverInstance.playitLinking.source: Waiting for confirmation in the browser…

serverInstance.playitPitch.source: Still fighting with the connection? Link a free playit.gg account (one click, no card) and the address will always work, no router needed.

serverWorlds.empty.source: No world generated yet — it's created automatically the first time the server starts.

serverWorlds.hint.source: Worlds detected in the server's folder.

settings.font.hint.source: Applies instantly, no need to restart the launcher.

settings.java.hint.source: They install automatically the first time an instance needs them — no need to install Java by hand.

settings.multiInstance.hint.source: If you open an instance while another is already running, you'll get a heads-up first (same account can break multiplayer; different accounts only affect performance). You can turn this warning off here.

settings.quality.reduceMotion.hint.source: Independent override from the quality profile: turns off decorative animations/transitions without dropping to Lite. Picking Lite still enables it like before; this lets you request it manually on Balanced or Experience.

settings.surface.incompatibleTitle.source: OLED surface not compatible with light mode

settings.theme.lightDisabledTitle.source: Light mode not compatible with OLED surface

settings.updates.betaHint.source: Betas are early previews of what is coming: they arrive sooner but may have bugs. You can turn them off any time.

settings.updates.betaWarningMessage.source: Beta versions are early previews: they may contain bugs, crash, or leave your instances in an odd state. Back up any important worlds before trying them. You can turn them off any time, but the launcher does not go back to the stable version by itself: you stay on the beta until a newer stable version is released.

settings.updates.hint.source: With this on, the launcher checks for and downloads updates by itself on startup, in the background, without getting in your way — you choose when to restart to apply them. With it off, updates are only checked manually from here.

settings.updates.ready.source: Update v{{version}} is ready to install.

sidebar.noInstancesYet.source: You haven't created any instance yet

sidebar.offline.source: No connection — play what you already have installed

skinManager.noCapes.source: This account has no capes — they come from Mojang events/promotions.

skinManager.skinLoadError.source: Couldn't load the skin texture — try again in a moment

skinManager.viewerHint.source: Drag to rotate, scroll to zoom

tflSelection.empty.source: No modpacks in the selection yet.

tflSelection.needsLoaderInstance.source: You need an instance with Fabric, Forge, NeoForge or Quilt to install this pack.

tflSelection.noInstanceBuild.source: There is no build of this pack for that instance

tflSelection.noMatchingInstance.source: None of your instances match this pack's versions.

tflSelection.noVersionBuild.source: There is no build of this pack for that version

tflSelection.subtitle.source: Discover curated packs and add them to a compatible instance, or create a new one on the spot.

whatsNewTips.tip1.source: Ctrl+K (⌘K on Mac) opens a palette to jump between instances or actions without touching the mouse.

whatsNewTips.tip2.source: "TFL Selection" is the TFLives modified client library. Find TFLClient there and install it through this launcher.

whatsNewTips.tip3.source: Each instance has its own Mods, Shaders and Modpacks tab — nothing mixes between instances.

whatsNewTips.tip4.source: In Settings → Style you can change accent, surface, density, and even the animated background.

whatsNewTips.updatedToVersionNoNotes.source: It auto-updated to version {{version}}. The full details of what changed are in the GitHub Release.

whatsNewTips.viewTechnicalDetail.source: View the technical details on GitHub

workbench.accountsHint.source: Microsoft sessions, offline accounts and skins.

workbench.appearanceHint.source: Launcher style, colors, backgrounds and effects. Does not change Minecraft performance.

workbench.chartHint.source: Real samples every second while the process is running and the console is visible. Missing data leaves a gap. History remains after stopping, during this console session.

workbench.consoleHint.source: Logs and charts for Minecraft and servers. Changes apply immediately.

workbench.dragHint.source: Drag cards to reorder, or use the arrows. The log keeps its own space.

workbench.gameHint.source: Game memory and Java versions. Individual instances can override these values in Details.

workbench.generalHint.source: Language, local files and launcher storage.

workbench.logHint.source: Levels are detected from Java output; stderr without a level is marked as error. Original text is preserved.

workbench.noSettings.source: No matches. Try RAM, language, skin or charts.

workbench.saveError.source: Preferences could not be saved. They remain active in this window.

workbench.updatesHint.source: Installed version, update checks and beta channel.

worldBackups.hint.source: They are created automatically before updating mods. You can make one by hand any time and restore it if something goes wrong (the last 10 are kept).

worldBackups.noWorlds.source: This instance has no worlds to back up yet.

worldBackups.restored.source: Worlds restored. A backup of the previous state was saved first.

worldBackups.restoreMessage.source: Your current worlds will be replaced with the ones from the {{date}} backup. A backup of how they are now is saved first, in case you change your mind.
